newsitem.title: USA: Northwest launches summer fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Northwest launches summer fare sale.

text.p: Northwest Airlines said Wednesday it had begun a summer fare sale, offering savings of up to 50 percent on regular excursion fares, and children's one-way fares as low as $49.
Passengers can save up to 50 percent on regular excursion fares on select days. And depending on destination, children can fly for $49 to $99 each way based on a round-trip purchase.
Tickets must be purchased by April 14 and passengers must travel between May 6 and September 6, the company said.
Northwest said it is also offering discounts of up to 50 percent on regular excursion fares for travel completed by May 5.
